ARTICLE.STI.ART: Right to erasure (right to be forgotten)

ALINEA.P: The controller shall erase personal data where one of the following applies:

NP.TXT: the data are no longer necessary;
the data subject withdraws consent pursuant to Article 5(2), and there is no other ground;

PARAG.ALINEA: Point (a) of the first subparagraph shall not apply to public authorities.

ALINEA.P: For the purposes of this Regulation:

NP.TXT:
consent means any freely given indication of wishes
OJ L 119, 4.5.2016, p. 1.;
establishment means, as set out in Article 25(6) of Directive 95/46/EC, a stable arrangement;
where a controller has establishments in several States;
